description: Eastern philosophy decomposed. Buddhist epistemology + Madhyamaka emptiness + Yogacara mind-only, Daoism wu-wei + naturalness, Confucian relational ethics, Indian philosophy (Vedanta, Samkhya, Nyaya), Zen + koans, Japanese aesthetics (wabi-sabi, ma).

sub_mechanisms.name: Madhyamaka_emptiness
sub_mechanisms.definition: Nagarjuna: nothing has intrinsic existence (svabhava). Sunyata. Mutual dependence.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation Buddhist philosophy. Two truths (conventional + ultimate). Influence: anti-essentialism. Modern: process philosophy parallels.

sub_mechanisms.name: Yogacara_mind_only
sub_mechanisms.definition: Vasubandhu, Asanga: external world is mental representation. Consciousness foundational.
sub_mechanisms.why: Idealist Buddhist school. Parallels: Berkeley, phenomenology. Influence: Zen, Chan Buddhism.

sub_mechanisms.name: Buddhist_epistemology_Dignaga
sub_mechanisms.definition: Two means of knowledge: perception (pratyaksha) + inference (anumana). Dignaga, Dharmakirti.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation Buddhist epistemology. Sophisticated logic + epistemology. Independent development paralleling Western.

sub_mechanisms.name: Daoism_wu_wei
sub_mechanisms.definition: Effortless action. Not inactivity but acting in accord with Dao.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation Daoism. Influence: aesthetics, statecraft, modern psychology (flow). Substrate's curiosity drive aligns somewhat.

sub_mechanisms.name: Daoism_ziran
sub_mechanisms.definition: Self-so. Spontaneous naturalness. Way things are in themselves.
sub_mechanisms.why: Daoist value. Letting things be rather than forcing. Ecological + ethical implications.

sub_mechanisms.name: Confucian_relational_self
sub_mechanisms.definition: Self constituted by relationships. Not atomistic individual. Ren in relation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation Confucian ethics. Contrast Western individualism. Modern: communitarianism, care ethics parallels.

sub_mechanisms.name: Advaita_Vedanta_brahman
sub_mechanisms.definition: Shankara: ultimate reality (Brahman) identical with self (Atman). Non-dualism.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation Hindu philosophy. Maya as veil over identity. Parallels: pure consciousness theories.

sub_mechanisms.name: Samkhya_dualism
sub_mechanisms.why: Classical Hindu dualism. Distinct from Cartesian (consciousness as pure witness, not thinker). Influence on yoga + meditation.

sub_mechanisms.name: Nyaya_logic
sub_mechanisms.definition: Five-membered inference. Proposition + reason + example + application + conclusion.
sub_mechanisms.why: Indian logic. Independent of Aristotelian. Foundation of Indian epistemology. Sophisticated.

sub_mechanisms.name: Zen_koan_method
sub_mechanisms.definition: Non-rational riddles for awakening. 'Sound of one hand clapping'.
sub_mechanisms.why: Breaks discursive thinking. Direct experience emphasised. Influence on creativity + cognitive science of insight.

sub_mechanisms.name: wabi_sabi_aesthetics
sub_mechanisms.definition: Beauty in imperfection, impermanence, incompleteness. Japanese aesthetic.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation Japanese aesthetic philosophy. Modern: counter to perfection ideals. Influence on design.

sub_mechanisms.name: ma_negative_space
sub_mechanisms.definition: Pause, gap, interval. Active emptiness. Foundation Japanese arts (music, garden, dance).
sub_mechanisms.why: Not Western negative space. Positively constitutive. Influence: architecture, computing UX (whitespace).

derivation_rules.name: Madhyamaka_anti_essentialism
then: found to be relational, conventionally existing
derivation_rules.why: Nagarjuna. Nothing has intrinsic existence; all relational. Parallels modern process + relational ontology. Anti-essentialism radical.

derivation_rules.name: wu_wei_effortless_skilful
derivation_rules.why: Dao De Jing. Modern: flow states (Csikszentmihalyi). Skilled action when self-consciousness drops. Foundation Daoist + skill philosophy.

derivation_rules.name: Confucian_self_in_relations
derivation_rules.definition: Self constituted by relationships, not atomic individual.
then: self exists in network of obligations + roles
derivation_rules.why: Father-son, ruler-subject, friend-friend. Foundation East Asian ethics. Contrast Western individualism. Modern care ethics parallels.

derivation_rules.name: Advaita_non_duality
then: ultimate reality is non-dual; appearances illusory (maya)
derivation_rules.why: Brahman = Atman. Subject-object distinction at deepest level dissolved. Influence on modern consciousness studies.

derivation_rules.name: koan_breaks_discursive_mind
derivation_rules.why: Logic fails: 'sound of one hand'. Aim: pre-conceptual insight. Modern: divergent thinking research. Insight psychology parallels.
